title: Read a star's barcode in 40 seconds
description:
Every element gives out its own exact colours. Hydrogen's red line sits at 656 nanometres. A yellow line in the Sun in 1868 led to helium.
Full lesson: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/#/light/spectra
Sources: Rimi Lab Cosmos, hydrogen's lines and a star's chemistry lesson. NIST constants and spectral tables.
